# Popover

Popover: a floating card next to its trigger with a title and richer content than a tooltip, such as details of
a person, a short form or a few actions. For a list of actions use Dropdown; for a confirmation use Popconfirm.

**Interaction**: it fades in from the side of the trigger. Opened by click (`trigger="click"`), focus moves to
the first focusable element inside it, or to the card itself; `Esc` or clicking the trigger closes it, and focus
returns to the trigger (when it is closed by clicking elsewhere on the page, focus stays on the clicked element).
Popovers opened on hover or focus do not move focus.

**Category**: Feedback · **Common uses**: Details of a person or a file on hover, a short form next to a button, filters

## Import

```ts
import { Popover } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Opens on hover, and on keyboard focus with `trigger={['hover', 'focus']}`; focus is not moved. The trigger must
accept mouse and focus events, such as Button, LinkButton or IconButton (layout primitives such as Inline do not).

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Inline gap={2} align="center">
      <Avatar name="Alex Morgan" size={28} />
      <Popover
        trigger={['hover', 'focus']}
        title="Alex Morgan"
        content={
          <Stack gap={1}>
            <Text size="sm" tone="secondary">
              Product designer · Design team
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm">alex.morgan@example.com</Text>
          </Stack>
        }
      >
        <LinkButton>Alex Morgan</LinkButton>
      </Popover>
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Opened by click

With `trigger="click"`, focus moves into the popover; `Esc` closes it and focus returns to the button.

```tsx
export function Click() {
  return (
    <Inline>
      <Popover
        trigger="click"
        title="Rename"
        content={
          <Stack gap={2}>
            <Input defaultValue="Website redesign" aria-label="Name" />
            <Inline gap={2} justify="end">
              <Button type="primary" size="small">
                Save
              </Button>
            </Inline>
          </Stack>
        }
      >
        <Button>Rename</Button>
      </Popover>
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Props

No props of its own.

Also accepts the props of the corresponding Ant Design component (`PopoverProps`), except `style` and `className`.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
